As a pet parent, you may want to keep an eye on your pup even when you’re out of the house, especially if your dog struggles with separation anxiety or has a medical condition. Dog cameras from Petco can allow you to see and speak to your pet to put them at ease no matter where you are. Best of all, most of these dog cameras also function as pet treat dispensers.

If you need to cheer up your dog during the day, an electronic pet treat dispenser can do the trick. Petco offers a variety of interactive pet treat dispensers, including mobile cameras that ensure your dog is always within sight. A pet webcam and treat dispenser is the perfect tool to give both you and your pet peace of mind.

Shop for your pet camera treat dispenser on the Petco website and have your purchase delivered to your door or to your local neighborhood Petco Pet Care Center. While you’re shopping, consider picking up other items to keep your dog entertained throughout the day, including puppy toys and interactive dog toys.

FAQs About Tech Treat Dispensers
What is the best camera to watch my dog?

Pet cameras can allow you to keep a close eye on your canine even when you are out of the house. The right dog camera for you will depend on the specific features you want as well as your budget. If you simply want to see your dog and are on a budget, a home security camera can do the trick. More advanced options can also let you hear your pet and speak to them through the camera.

If you’d like to interact more with your dog, a pet-specific camera can allow you to dispense treats to your pets. More advanced Wi-Fi pet cameras and treat dispensers can alert you when your dog is barking, when they become active or even when they look directly at the camera. You can even choose a camera that also works as a timed pet treat dispenser. The more features you want in your dog camera, the higher the price tag you can expect.

Are treat dispensing toys good for dogs?

Pet treat dispensers can be a positive addition to your canine household for a variety of reasons. The best dog treat dispensing toys can help keep your pet entertained and mentally stimulated, especially when you aren’t at home. They are also an excellent choice if your pup tends to gobble their food too quickly. You can find many different types of pet treat dispensers at Petco, including interactive toys that encourage your pup to solve puzzles and other toys that require your pet to play with the toy to get treats.

Just be sure to use your pet treat dispenser wisely. Dogs should only receive about 10% of their daily calories from treats. Too many treats can lead to obesity and related health problems. Ideally, you’ll want to put small, strong-smelling treats in your dog’s treat dispensing toy, so they learn to play with the toy. Over time, you can switch in pieces of kibble, or low-calorie treats. Take a look at other dog health and wellness supplies.

 Recommended snacks
 We recommend feeding a volume of less than 15mm*15mm*10mm snack, while the device does not support more powdered food, which is easy to jam.
 Couldn't throw away snacks
 Pour out the snacks from the snack chute.
 Turn the device upside down and open the hole cover with the device plugged in.
 Tap the side of the device and use the cool air mode of the hair dryer to blow into the hole cover for 30 seconds.
 Please use the snack throwing function in APP to launch snacks several times, and check if the issue is solved.
 Does Arenti Dog Camera have a built-in battery, or does it need to be charged?
 Arenti Dog Camera does not have a built-in battery. It is a non-rechargeable camera but needs to be plugged in to use.
 If there is no socket where you want to put the camera, you could choose an appropriate length extension cord for it to use! (Make sure whether the network of that location is stable)
 Power supply: DC 5V/2A
 Maximum power consumption: 5W
 Does it work with the 5GHz Wi-Fi network?
 Absolutely yes! The Arenti Dog Camera support both 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi frequencies.
Since they both have their advantages, to give you the best experience with the camera, we recommend connecting to a Wi-Fi network that has a better signal in your house.
2.4GHz Wi-Fi will provide better Internet if the camera is in a spacious location, or if there is a wall between your camera and the router. If your camera is near a router, 5GHz Wi-Fi will be a good choice to provide a more stable and robust connection with less interference in a small room.
 Can cats also work?
 Of course you could also feed your cat's favorite snacks by Arenti Dog Camera! Please refer to the Recommended snacks for advice.
Cats will adapt and enjoy this quickly because they are very smart:)
Please note that bark detection may not be triggered as cats do not bark, while you could be assured that other features are perfectly suitable for cats.
 Can it record the activity moment of the pet?
 Of course! Please insert SD card/subscribe to cloud storage, and make the following settings: 
1. Enable recording: APP - Device (click the device to the live video page) - Set Recording Management; 
2. Enable alarm: APP - Device (click the device to the real-time video page) - Set Alarm Settings
 Does it have a bark sensor?
 Yes! You could receive notifications from the APP when your dog barks. 
Note: Make sure the APP notification & bark detection are on.
 How long is the warranty?
 The warranty period is 2 years. Please contact our customer service team at support@arenti.com to solve the problem if there are any questions about the product. Once it is confirmed that there is an issue with the device, we will replace a new one for totally free:)

 What is the best dog camera with treat dispenser in 2026?

 Do dog cameras actually help with separation anxiety?
 Camera interaction — seeing your dog and tossing treats remotely — can provide brief reassurance for mild-to-moderate separation anxiety. Research from the American Veterinary Society of Animal Behavior suggests owner presence — even via two-way audio — reduces cortisol levels in some dogs during short separations. However, cameras are a monitoring and limited-interaction tool, not a treatment. Dogs with severe separation anxiety typically require desensitization protocols, possibly medication, and guidance from a certified applied animal behaviorist.

 Continuous 1080p streaming uses approximately 1–2GB per hour. If you're actively watching your dog for 2 hours daily, that's 60–120GB/month.
